# Zadoc

> Zadoc is a skincare app for Cameroon and francophone Africa. A user takes
> one photo of their face, and Zadoc builds a skin profile (type and
> condition) using AI vision analysis, then recommends which natural oils
> genuinely suit that skin and which to avoid.

## Key facts
- Zadoc replaces guesswork and influencer-driven oil picks with a
  photo-based skin profile.
- Unlocking a full profile costs a small one-time fee, paid via mobile
  money (Fapshi).
- Zadoc is not a medical service and does not diagnose skin conditions —
  it recommends skincare oils based on a general skin-type read.
- Built and operated by Terabyte, based in Buea, Cameroon.

## Primary use case
Someone unsure which face oil (argan, rosehip, jojoba, marula, etc.) fits
their skin, who wants an answer faster and cheaper than a dermatology
visit.
